RequireRegularFile.summary: Returns normally only when the observed entry is a regular file, rather than a link or special entry.
RequireRegularFile.param: Path to inspect. This observation does not reserve the path against later changes.
RequireRegularFile.exception: The entry is missing, nonregular, or cannot be inspected by the native API.
Access to the entry is denied by a managed filesystem operation.
The path is empty or contains a null character.
RequireRegularFile.remarks: Use this capability only on its provider OS. Native library or entry-point loading failures propagate. Path inspection and rename do not reserve ancestor directories against concurrent changes. Native error details vary by OS; do not parse exception messages as outcomes.

Move.summary: Returns the native outcome and error code. Success is the publication boundary and cannot be undone by cancellation.
Move.param: Existing source path. Relative paths use the process working directory.
Destination path on the same filesystem.
Zero on success; otherwise the OS error (POSIX errno or Windows GetLastError).
Move.returns: The native result. Unavailable represents an operation failure, not an absent capability.
Move.exception: A path is empty or contains a null character.
Move.remarks: Use this capability only on its provider OS. Native library or entry-point loading failures propagate. Path inspection and rename do not reserve ancestor directories against concurrent changes. Native error details vary by OS; do not parse exception messages as outcomes.

RevealAsync.summary: Requests selection of an existing file or directory in its containing folder.
RevealAsync.param: Absolute path of the entry to select; ownership remains with the caller.
Cancellation observed before native submission, not after successful handoff.
RevealAsync.returns: A task that completes after submission and owned helper cleanup, without guaranteeing visible selection or foreground focus.
RevealAsync.remarks: No host UI dispatcher is required. Native helpers are awaited; the file manager's lifetime is not. A failed selection request does not fall back to opening only the folder. Native exception types and details can vary by OS; preserve them for diagnostics rather than parsing messages.
RevealAsync.exception: The path is blank, contains a null character, or is not absolute.
The entry is missing, inaccessible to a native service, or native submission fails.
The provider is invoked on another OS.
A Windows Shell COM operation fails.

OpenAsync.summary: Hands an existing file to a host-selected application without changing file associations.
OpenAsync.param: Absolute file path; directories are rejected and ownership remains with the caller.
Explicit executable, bundle, or desktop-entry target supported by the provider.
Cancellation observed before native submission. Later cancellation does not terminate the application.
OpenAsync.returns: A task that completes after native submission and owned helper cleanup, not after the document loads or the application exits.
OpenAsync.remarks: No host UI dispatcher is required. Executables receive the file path as one argument without shell parsing. Unsupported or failed explicit targets never fall back to the default application. Native launch failures may surface as OS-specific exceptions. Preserve error details for diagnostics rather than parsing exception messages.
OpenAsync.exception: The path or application is null.
The path is blank, contains a null character, or is not absolute.
An entry is missing, is of the wrong kind, or native handoff fails.
The executable or native helper cannot be started.
The provider does not support the selected target kind.
The provider is invoked on another OS.

EnumerateColorProfiles.summary: Enumerates installed profiles on a worker thread without a UI loop.
EnumerateColorProfiles.param: Cancels between native operations; native calls already running are joined.
EnumerateColorProfiles.returns: Observed entries and completeness. Recoverable enumeration problems retain independently observed entries.
EnumerateColorProfiles.exception: Cancellation was requested; it is never reported as an incomplete success.
The provider does not match the executing OS.
EnumerateColorProfiles.remarks: Native loading or unrecoverable failures can throw. A complete scan describes only the provider's documented coverage.

ReadColorProfile.summary: Reads the current bytes for an observed provider key, subject to its configured byte limit.
ReadColorProfile.param: Nonempty provider-owned key returned by discovery; embedded NUL is rejected.
Cancels before/after native operations and during asynchronous file reads.
ReadColorProfile.returns: Profile bytes owned by the returned result, without ICC parsing or conversion.
ReadColorProfile.exception: The key is empty or contains NUL.
The profile cannot be read or changed during the read.
The profile exceeds the byte limit.
The provider does not match the executing OS.
ReadColorProfile.remarks: Access denial and native loading failures may also propagate. Keys do not establish continued availability.

NormalizeAbsolute.summary: Normalizes an absolute native path, retaining significant filename characters. Relative paths are rejected.
NormalizeAbsolute.param: Absolute host-native path; the working directory is never used.
NormalizeAbsolute.returns: A lexical absolute path; no existence, alias resolution, or lease ownership is established.
NormalizeAbsolute.exception: The path is not an admitted absolute native path.
The syntax does not match the runtime host.

ToFileUri.summary: Encodes an absolute native path as an escaped file URI. Directory references end with a slash.
ToFileUri.param: Absolute native path; no filesystem existence or file-kind check occurs.
Whether to produce a directory reference, independently of existence.
ToFileUri.exception: The path is not an admitted absolute native path or contains malformed Unicode.
The syntax does not match the runtime host.

TryFromFileUri.summary: Decodes an admitted absolute file URI, returning false for malformed or foreign evidence.
TryFromFileUri.param: Normalized native path on success; null otherwise.
TryFromFileUri.returns: Whether the URI has an admitted local representation.
TryFromFileUri.remarks: Queries, fragments, credentials, ports, encoded separators, malformed Unicode/UTF-8, and Windows device namespaces are rejected. This does not resolve aliases or assert existence. Invocation requires a matching runtime host.
